entities.name: monopod
entities.relation: single-leg support that carries lens weight while leaving the shooter free to move

entities.name: tripod
entities.relation: three-leg support that stands on its own and holds framing for slow shutter speeds and video

entities.name: monopod with feet
entities.relation: hybrid monopod with a small fold-out base that stands briefly and pivots

entities.name: tilt head
entities.relation: single-axis head that tilts a long lens up and down on a monopod

entities.name: gimbal head
entities.relation: balanced head for heavy telephoto lenses, usually on a tripod

entities.name: fluid head
entities.relation: damped video head for smooth pans when filming sports

entities.name: ball head
entities.relation: free-moving head; on a monopod it mainly helps vertical shots

entities.name: lens collar
entities.relation: tripod foot on a telephoto lens that should carry the mount instead of the camera body

entities.name: 70-200mm f/2.8
entities.relation: the classic sideline lens many shooters handhold or put on a monopod

entities.name: super telephoto
entities.relation: 400mm f/2.8 to 600mm f/4 class lens that almost always needs a monopod or tripod

entities.name: shutter speed
entities.relation: fast speeds freeze action; slow speeds for panning blur favor more support

entities.name: image stabilization
entities.relation: in-lens or in-body stabilization that reduces the need for support

entities.name: sideline
entities.relation: crowded field-side area where tripods are often impractical or not allowed

entities.name: flip lock
entities.relation: lever lock you can check by eye; fast to extend

entities.name: twist lock
entities.relation: rotating collar lock; slimmer, half-turn to release on some monopods

entities.name: Arca-Swiss
entities.relation: dovetail plate standard used by most quick-release clamps

entities.name: iFootage Cobra 3
entities.relation: pedal-base carbon monopod recommended by sports and wildlife shooters
